encounter: E0007 TRAINER_DARIAN; playtest block P1, cap 14, attempt 1
availability_audit: Every member is drawn from work/reference-pools/pool-14.json with gate<=14, the legality rule this playtest brief uses for the cap-14 window. Roots are recorded per member. Caveat carried in each receipt: some cap-14 roots (VerdanturfMeadow, RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, Route115/116, AlteringCave) sit later in campaign chronology than the Route 102/103/104 fights in this block, so this is a cap-window-legal party, not a party a player literally holds at Petalburg Woods. Held items are ordinary free preparation-catalogue items, one of each, no duplicates.
plan: Darian is four Waters with two setup lines, so the party answers both at once. Iron Leaves leads for the Grass pressure the dossier names as the crack on three of the four (4x on Water/Ground Barboach) while its Grass/Psychic body resists Water, Ground and Electric - the three attacking types on this team that matter. Whimsicott partners it as the direct SETUP denial: Prankster Taunt and Encore both outspeed Dragon Dance and Shell Smash regardless of stage, and Whimsicott is a second Water resist. Magearna's Thunderbolt is held back deliberately as the Volt Absorb probe on Chinchou. Snorlax is the Sludge Bomb switch-in that neither Grass is.

party.role: powder-immune physical breaker; Grass/Psychic resists Water, Electric, Ground, Grass and Fighting, which covers most of this block
Prankster speed control and setup denial: priority Taunt/Encore answers Belly Drum, Shell Smash, Dragon Dance, Swords Dance, Trick Room and Rain Dance
Steel/Fairy special wall-breaker; resists Normal/Flying/Bug/Grass/Dark, and its single-target Electric line is the Lightning Rod / Volt Absorb redirection probe
Thick Fat blanket against Fire and Ice; Rocky Helmet punishes the contact attackers and multi-hit users in this block
Intimidate pivot, Fire/Bug/Grass/Steel breaker, Extreme Speed revenge priority
fastest member; Knock Off strips the Eviolite/Life Orb/Berry economy this block runs on, and Fake Out contests the opposing Fake Out tempo
